about: The Campaign Shelf on ww2dispatches.com/campaign-series (Site Revamp doc). One entry per volume, in volume order. A volume whose folder campaign-series/<id>/ holds day records is built as a live volume page; the others show a stamped cover and the note. Edit by hand; renderer/site_pages.py reads it. runYear is the year the series posts in (a day's run date is its historical day and month in runYear, stepping up a year after December, unless the day record has a postDate). cover is a photo in this repo; cloth is the clothbound color; w and h size the spine in pixels.

volumes.title: Pearl Harbor
volumes.intro: Twelve days to war, told as they happened.
volumes.blurb: From the morning Japan's carriers slip out of the Kurils to the midget submarines creeping toward Oahu in the dark.

volumes.title: The Bulge
volumes.blurb: Hitler's last gamble in the West, from the dawn barrage in the Ardennes to the battle's official end.
volumes.note: First dispatch 16 Dec 2026 at 6:30 a.m. Mountain. Days appear here as they post.

volumes.title: Stalingrad
volumes.blurb: The battle that turned the war in the East. Under consideration for a future year.
